backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing game logic with player profiles, energy/XP/levels, planted coins, AR spot claims, monsters, daily limits, chat, Stripe integration, and migration from Principal-based to UserId-based storage.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that converts dailyLimits from Principal-keyed to UserId-keyed maps by assigning sequential UserIds to existing entries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two requirements: displaying canister architecture with Principal/UserID info on Banco Central page, and ensuring unified UserID-based data access across all canisters.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of frontend files including App.tsx with routing, profile/wallet/DAO pages, modals, navigation components, and styling with OKLCH color system and QMY token utilities.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with Quantumoney.app metadata, SEO tags, Open Graph/Twitter cards, viewport-fit for safe areas, and Google Fonts preconnect for Playfair Display and Inter.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React app with TanStack Router setup, QueryClient provider, ThemeProvider, LanguageProvider, and routes for home, wallet, DAO, profile, map, presale, docs, and institutional pages.
frontend/src/components/Container.tsx: Reusable container component with responsive padding and configurable max-width sizes (sm, md, lg, xl, full).
frontend/src/components/CookieConsentBan: Cookie consent banner component that displays a dismissible notification with accept/learn-more actions, using the useCookieConsent hook and showing after a 1-second delay if consent hasn't been given.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component displaying a four-column layout with logo, resources links (QMY Token, Wallet, Bank, Chat, Presale), governance links (DAO, Pre-Proposals), and legal links (Terms, Privacy, Gold Paper, Docs).
frontend/src/components/gold-paper/GoldP: Displays an interactive global distribution map for 600M QMY tokens across hotspots with animated stars, showing allocation details and regional breakdowns when a hotspot is selected.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Fixed header component with logo, desktop navigation menu (Home, QMY Token, Wallet, AR Profile, Map, Bank, DAO, Chat), LoginButton, and mobile menu toggle.
frontend/src/components/InstitutionalExp: Section wrapper component that displays a prominent disclaimer banner (MiCA/GDPR compliant) indicating content is conceptual/non-operational, with multilingual support (PT/EN) and customizable title.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that renders Header, Footer, CookieConsentBanner, lazy-loaded QuantumUniverseScene background, and Outlet for nested routes.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Internet Identity login/logout button component that displays principal ID when authenticated, handles login/logout with query cache clearing, and shows loading states.
frontend/src/components/PageShell.tsx: Simple wrapper component that provides consistent page structure with minimum height, top padding for fixed header, and optional className prop.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleL: Interactive explorer component for presale phases, displaying phase details including allocation, price per token, bonus percentage, and minimum purchase with phase selection buttons.
frontend/src/components/presale/PresaleU: Visualizes token unlock schedule over vesting months with a timeline showing monthly unlock amounts and cumulative percentage unlocked with progress bars.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARCoinBa: Displays QTM coin balance breakdown showing total, available, locked (planted), and bonus coins with visual cards and explanatory notes in Portuguese.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARMonste: Shows captured AR monsters collection with icons, capture timestamps, energy boosts, and total energy calculation; displays empty state when no monsters are captured.
frontend/src/components/profile/ARPlayer: Displays player XP and level statistics with progress bar showing XP needed for next level and current level benefits in Portuguese.
frontend/src/components/profile/Canister: Displays a panel showing the architecture of 7 unified canisters (Frontend, Game Logic, Governance, Profile, DAO, Bridge, Extra) with their IDs, functions, and the user's Principal ID and derived UserID for authentication tracking.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileG: A reusable wrapper component that renders a glass-morphism styled card with a transparent background, backdrop blur, and yellow border for profile UI elements.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileH: Renders a fixed overlay HUD in the top-right corner displaying player profile stats including nickname, energy, XP, level, and token balances (available, planted, bonus QTM).
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileP: Displays three placeholder cards for upcoming features: Captured Monsters, Recent Activity, and Quick Actions, each with an icon and 'Coming soon' message.
frontend/src/components/profile/Technica: A temporary validation panel showing Principal ID, internal UserID, active canister IDs, and last data read timestamp with loading/error states for technical debugging purposes.
frontend/src/components/profile/useProfi: Custom hook that derives authentication and registration state from identity and profile data, determining whether to show profile setup UI.
frontend/src/components/quantum/QuantumU: A Three.js/React Three Fiber 3D scene rendering animated quantum particles in gold/amber/violet colors, a pulsing torus field, and stars with mouse parallax effects as a background universe visualization.
frontend/src/components/ReadOnlyBanner.t: Banner component displaying a lock icon and customizable message indicating read-only/disabled transfer functionality, typically used for institutional dashboards.
frontend/src/components/SectionNavigator: Full-screen overlay navigation menu displaying a grid of all app sections with icons, labels, and availability badges (Available/Coming Soon), closable via X button.
frontend/src/components/StatusBadge.tsx: Badge component displaying status indicators (draft, planned, coming-soon) with corresponding icons and color schemes for content availability states.
frontend/src/components/Typography.tsx: Exports reusable typography components (PageTitle, SectionTitle, SubsectionTitle, BodyText) with consistent styling using Tailwind classes and optional icons.
frontend/src/components/wallet/QMYTransa: Displays a transaction history card for QMY tokens with loading, error, empty, and populated states, showing transaction details with icons for transfer, mint, and burn operations.
frontend/src/components/wallet/SendQMYSi: React component that renders a card UI for simulating QMY token transfers with form inputs for destination principal and amount, displaying validation errors and success toasts.
frontend/src/components/wallet/VestingBr: React component displaying vesting information for QMY tokens, showing available and locked balances with a progress bar and countdown timer for the next unlock event.
frontend/src/contexts/LanguageContext.ts: React context provider for managing application language (Portuguese/English) with translations for navigation and footer elements, persisting selection to localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages a backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useARGameData.ts: React Query hook that fetches and aggregates AR game data (XP, level, coins, captured monsters) from four different IC canisters using the Dfinity agent and authenticated identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useCookieConsent.ts: React hook for managing cookie consent state in localStorage with methods to give or revoke consent.
frontend/src/hooks/useDao.ts: React Query hooks for DAO functionality including fetching proposals and voting, currently using simulated in-memory storage with plans to integrate canister calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useICPLedger.ts: React Query hook that fetches real ICP balance from the on-chain ledger using an authenticated identity and the ICPLedgerClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useLuxuryBank.ts: React Query hook that fetches and derives luxury bank dashboard data including token supply overview, time series, category breakdown, and metrics from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/usePublicChat.ts: Local-only chat hook that manages in-memory messages with simulated sending delay, without backend persistence.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYLedger.ts: React Query hook that fetches real QMY token balance from the on-chain ICRC ledger canister using authenticated identity.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYTransactions.ts: React Query hook that retrieves QMY transaction history from the ICRC ledger canister for the authenticated user's principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useQMYVesting.ts: React Query hook for QMY vesting information that currently returns null as vesting data is not exposed on-chain.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for player profile operations including fetching, saving, registering, and retrieving player state from the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSimulatedQMYVestin: Hook that simulates QMY token vesting locally using localStorage, calculating available and locked amounts based on a simulation start date.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom dark theme color variables, utility classes for safe areas, glass morphism effects, and QMY-specific styling.
Utility functions for financial calculations and formatting including percentage changes, currency formatting, large number abbreviation, and sparkline SVG path generation.
frontend/src/lib/dao/preProposalsData.ts: Defines PreProposal interface and provides mock data for DAO governance proposals covering treasury allocation, AR distribution, vesting optimization, and developer grants.
frontend/src/lib/icp/account.ts: Implements ICP account identifier derivation from Principal using a development-only SHA-224 hash and CRC32 checksum, with functions to convert principals to hex account identifiers.
frontend/src/lib/icp/ledgerClient.ts: Provides an ICP Ledger client for querying account balances via the mainnet ledger canister, with utilities to format e8s amounts to human-readable ICP values.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/icrc.idl.ts: Defines the Candid IDL interface for ICRC-1 token standard methods including name, symbol, decimals, balance_of, and metadata queries.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/ledgerClient.ts: Implements an ICRC-1 ledger client for querying token metadata and balances, with utilities to format raw token amounts using decimal precision.
frontend/src/lib/icrc/transactions.ts: Attempts to query ICRC-1 transaction history for an account, returning null if the optional transactions method is not supported by the canister.
frontend/src/lib/map/mapDatasets.ts: Defines marker datasets for coins and monsters at real-world geographic locations (landmarks, cities) used for AR gameplay map visualization.
frontend/src/lib/map/simulatedMapProject: Implements a simple equirectangular projection to convert latitude/longitude coordinates to x/y screen positions with zoom and centering support.
frontend/src/lib/offline-manager.ts: Empty file, likely a placeholder for offline data management functionality.
Provides simulated central bank data for QMY token including supply distribution, usage statistics, presale info, and geographic breakdown.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/goldPaperSimData.ts: Defines simulated strategic token distribution data for geographic hotspots (landmarks) with allocations and regional breakdowns for the Gold Paper feature.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/presaleSimData.ts: Provides simulated presale phase data including seed, private, and public sale rounds with pricing, bonuses, and allocation details.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedSend.ts: Simulates QMY token transfer with validation for principal format, amount, and balance, returning success or error after a delay with 90% success rate.
frontend/src/lib/qmy/simulatedVesting.ts: Calculates token vesting schedule with initial unlock and monthly releases over time, returning available, locked amounts and next unlock date.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient and InternetIdentityProvider context wrappers around the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: About page describing the Quantumoney ecosystem with two separate systems (Quantumoney.app for documentation and QuantumoneyAR.app for gaming), emphasizing they are independent with no shared ledger or token synchronization.
frontend/src/pages/ARDistributionPage.ts: Displays a conceptual AR distribution model page with disclaimers that no tokens are distributed and all content is educational/informational only, including compliance notices for MiCA and GDPR.
frontend/src/pages/ARMode.tsx: Placeholder page for an Augmented Reality experience with a camera icon and "coming soon" message.
frontend/src/pages/BancoCentral.tsx: Luxury bank dashboard displaying QMY token metrics (total supply, circulating, locked), KPI tiles, time series data with sparklines, and canister architecture panel for comprehensive analytics.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Bilingual contact page (Portuguese/English) displaying helpdesk email and website URL with glass-card styling.
frontend/src/pages/DAOCreateProposalPage: Form page for creating DAO proposals with authentication and registration checks, allowing logged-in registered users to submit proposals with title and description.
frontend/src/pages/DAOPage.tsx: DAO governance page displaying active proposals with authentication/registration gates, allowing registered users to create and view proposals through navigation to detail and creation pages.
frontend/src/pages/DAOProposalDetailPage: Displays detailed view of a DAO proposal with voting functionality (yes/no/abstain), vote revocation, and vote tallies. Requires authentication to vote and uses React Query hooks for data fetching and mutations.
frontend/src/pages/DocsPage.tsx: Documentation hub page displaying a grid of nine documentation sections (Gold Paper, Tokenomics, Technical Architecture, etc.) with status badges and educational disclaimers about conceptual/draft nature of content.
frontend/src/pages/GameSystemsPage.tsx: Describes AR game mechanics for QuantumoneyAR.app including energy system, monster capture, and token planting/rescue features. Includes bilingual content (PT/EN) and disclaimers that the game is separate from the institutional site with no live synchronization.
frontend/src/pages/GoldPaper.tsx: Institutional documentation page presenting the conceptual framework of Quantumoney (QMY) ecosystem with table of contents covering vision, tokenomics, governance, technical architecture, and legal compliance. Includes educational disclaimers and draft status badge.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page with animated galaxy background, QMY logo with glow effects, language toggle (PT/EN), and call-to-action button to install the QuantumoneyAR app. Features animated text displaying project mission statement.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Landing page with hero section featuring logo, title, and CTA button, plus a features section showcasing Wallet, Swap, and Rewards with animated cards and icons.
frontend/src/pages/LegalPage.tsx: Legal and compliance page displaying regulatory notices (MiCA, GDPR, KYC/AML) and disclaimers about QMY not being a financial product, with bilingual content (Portuguese and English).
frontend/src/pages/MapMode.tsx: Interactive global map page displaying simulated QMY coin and monster locations at famous landmarks, with controls for adjusting center coordinates and zoom level using SVG projection.
frontend/src/pages/Perfil.tsx: User profile page handling authentication, player registration, and profile editing with nickname management, using Internet Identity and displaying profile/player state data.
frontend/src/pages/PreProposalDetailPage: Detail page for individual DAO pre-proposals showing title, category, description, objective, impact, and full details with navigation back to proposals list.
frontend/src/pages/PreProposalsPage.tsx: Displays a list of educational pre-proposals for community review before DAO submission, with cards showing title, description, objective, impact, and navigation to detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/PresalePage.tsx: Displays informational/simulated QMY presale data including phases, token allocation, vesting periods, and unlock schedules with interactive explorers and visualizations.
frontend/src/pages/PrivacyPolicyPage.tsx: Renders the privacy policy page with sections on data collection, usage, storage, user rights, GDPR/LGPD compliance, and location/camera permissions.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays AR game profile with authentication via Internet Identity, showing player stats, coin balance, monster collection, and technical validation panels with quantum universe background.
frontend/src/pages/PublicChatPage.tsx: Implements a session-only public chat interface with message display and submission form, using simulated in-memory storage that doesn't persist across reloads.
frontend/src/pages/QMYTokenPage.tsx: Displays QMY token information page with key features (real token, swappable, secure, decentralized), token details, use cases, and technical specifications using card-based layout with icons.
frontend/src/pages/QTMRules.tsx: Placeholder page for QTM game rules using PageShell and Container components with a "coming soon" message.
frontend/src/pages/RoadmapPage.tsx: Conceptual roadmap page with prominent disclaimers stating no commitments or guarantees, emphasizing theoretical development phases and regulatory compliance (MiCA, GDPR).
frontend/src/pages/SwapPage.tsx: Swap page requiring Internet Identity authentication that displays a "coming soon" message with ReadOnlyBanner, indicating swap functionality is currently disabled.
frontend/src/pages/TechnicalPage.tsx: Technical architecture page documenting four canisters (frontend, docs, QMY logic, governance) with multilingual support, emphasizing conceptual/non-operational nature and compliance disclaimers.
frontend/src/pages/TermsOfServicePage.ts: Terms of Service page covering eligibility, user accounts, acceptable use, content ownership, simulated features, updates, and liability limitations in Portuguese.
frontend/src/pages/TokenomicsPage.tsx: Displays a conceptual tokenomics page with disclaimers that QMY is not a financial product, includes sections for token framework, locked/unlocked balances, and compliance notices for MiCA and GDPR.
frontend/src/pages/TreasuryMonetaryPolic: Presents a conceptual treasury and monetary policy page with educational content, disclaimers about no real financial operations, and placeholder sections for treasury model, vesting framework, and monetary policy pending final documentation.
Displays vesting schedule and deflation mechanics with bilingual support (English/Portuguese), showing charts for vesting timeline and burn progress dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Wallet dashboard page that requires Internet Identity authentication, displays QMY and ICP balances, vesting breakdown, transaction history, and includes simulated QMY sending functionality with read-only banner.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for parsing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state like admin tokens across navigation.
frontend/src/VALIDATION_REQUIRED.md: Documentation of completed institutional-safe foundation changes including draft Gold Paper, read-only wallet with on-chain queries, Internet Identity login, and MiCA/GDPR compliant placeholders without active crypto features.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with extended color palette (gold, amber, quantum-violet, electric-blue), custom typography settings, luxury-themed shadows, and custom animations for fade-in, depth-emerge, and shimmer effects.
project_state.json: Project configuration defining a cryptocurrency game platform architecture with 7 canisters for different functions (frontend, game logic, governance, profile, DAO, bridge, extra data). Documents the critical issue that the system currently uses Principal directly as UserID instead of a unified internal UserID, preventing cross-domain synchronization between Quantumoney.app and QuantumoneyAR.app.
